title: Best user research tools in 2026: 22 platforms compared
summary: Compare 22 user research platforms in 2026 on research methods, AI features, recruitment, and security. Ten in-depth profiles plus a buyer's checklist. Updated quarterly.
body_markdown: Carly Hartshorn is a Marketing Manager at Great Question, where she leads the webinar program and partnerships, among other Marketing initiatives. She works closely with research and design leaders across the industry to bring practical, experience-driven perspectives to the Great Question community.
